normalization: All guide counts divided by each sample total, times 1e6; log2(CPM+1).
gene_sample_summary: Mean of log2(CPM+1) across mapped guides within each animal, then group mean hPi minus group mean no-PBMC. Guides are not biological replicates.
leave_one_animal_out: Drop each of 12 graft animals once; recompute group mean contrast.
leave_one_guide_out: Drop each candidate guide once; recompute gene sample summaries and contrast.
baseline_covariates: Mapped guide count; mean no-PBMC CPM averaged across gene guides and animals; mean pre-transplant CPM across available labeled pre-transplant samples.
matched_background: If full scored-universe mapping is available: same number of mapped guides as candidate, and same quintile of mean no-PBMC guide CPM and pre-transplant guide CPM. Report strata size and mark unresolved if fewer than 20 noncandidate peers. No replacing primary analysis.
mouse_library_eligibility: Use published library name and versioned public annotation. If annotation or one-to-one species mapping unavailable, explicitly retain unresolved selection bias.
uncertainty: Descriptive leave-one-out ranges only, not confidence intervals or independent donor inference. No negative binomial model in this arm.
no_changes_after_outcomes: Any deviations must be recorded with reason.
annotation_policy: Main raw descriptive analysis uses Broad CP0043 original-target chip 20220324 (gene design identity), with GRCh38 strict NCBI chip 20240130 concordance audit; gene symbol change only when authority matches stable identifier.
mouse_eligibility_rule: A human score gene is eligible when its exact human symbol occurs in a frozen MGI HOM_MouseHumanSequence homology class with a mouse symbol listed verbatim in Addgene Mouse GeCKOv2 A. A later alias reconciliation is separately logged. No capitalization-only orthology. Restrict the published-score background to this eligible union; report candidate coverage and ambiguity. Current homology report is snapshot-hashed.
mouse_alias_reconciliation: Resolve exact current symbols first, then unique MGI MRK_List2.rpt synonyms among current mouse homology records. Exclude ambiguous aliases; log mapping in raw_mouse_eligibility.csv. Freeze before outcomes.

post_primary_outcome_amendment.primary_outcome_known: theta 0.4209678; no positive significant candidate; HIVEP2 and GCN1 have positive published scores but negative total-CPM descriptive contrasts
post_primary_outcome_amendment.reason: Diagnostic to isolate the reference-control contribution to the sign discrepancy; cannot replace the primary analysis or raw contrast.
post_primary_outcome_amendment.analysis: Exploratory NT-centered descriptive contrast: candidate animal-level mean log2(CPM+1) minus animal-level mean log2(CPM+1) of all strict-chip NO_SITE guides; compare group means and repeat animal/guide omissions
post_primary_outcome_amendment.NT_definition: Broad CP0043 GRCh38 NCBI strict 20240130 annotation with Gene Symbol beginning NO_SITE_; exactly 941 barcodes, matching publication stated count but historical membership equivalence not proven
post_primary_outcome_amendment.interpretation: Simple descriptive difference-in-differences, not fitted negative-binomial random-effects model, no p-values
